runtimes.name: node
runtimes.label: Portable Node.js

darwin-arm64.notes: Use the official macOS arm64 Node 24+ tarball. The macOS launcher extracts node-v24-darwin-arm64.tar.gz from runtime-archives/macos on first run when bundled.

darwin-x64.notes: Use the official macOS x64 Node 24+ tarball. The macOS launcher extracts node-v24-darwin-x64.tar.gz from runtime-archives/macos on first run when bundled.

runtimes.notes: Use the official Windows standalone zip. Extract so node.exe is available under runtimes/windows/node.

runtimes.name: python
runtimes.label: Portable Python

darwin-arm64.notes: Use a macOS arm64 Python 3.11+ standalone tarball. The macOS launcher extracts python-3.11-darwin-arm64.tar.gz from runtime-archives/macos when bundled.

darwin-x64.notes: Use a macOS x64 Python 3.11+ standalone tarball. The macOS launcher extracts python-3.11-darwin-x64.tar.gz from runtime-archives/macos when bundled.

runtimes.notes: Use the official Windows embeddable package. It is isolated and does not include pip by default.

runtimes.name: git
runtimes.label: Portable Git
runtimes.notes: Use Git for Windows Portable, also called the thumbdrive edition.
